fusions.name: Harvest Arc
fusions.desc: Sweeps a curved arc of spores 5 tiles long that deals 13 damage to everything caught in it. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Reaped Bloom
fusions.desc: Flicks a spore from the harvest at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 8 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. You hold 3 charges, and kills give them back.

fusions.name: Reaper's Tonic
fusions.desc: Restores 20 health to you, with a 10% chance to be a critical heal. Its healing rises 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%).

fusions.name: Second Cutting
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, you regain 3 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
